dashboard.label: SOC Lab — Synthetic Telemetry Overview
dashboard.description: Historical fixture data. These panels count events, not confirmed incidents. Analyst decisions are documented in the investigation reports.

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype="soc:json" | dedup event_uid | timechart span=5m fixedrange=false count by event_type
index=soc_lab sourcetype="soc:json" | stats dc(event_uid) AS events by hostname | sort - events

panel.title: Failed authentications by source and user

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype="soc:json" event_type="authentication" result="failure" | stats dc(event_uid) AS failures by hostname username src_ip | sort - failures
index=soc_lab sourcetype="soc:json" event_type="network_connection" | stats dc(event_uid) AS attempts by hostname dest_ip result | sort - attempts
